title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8959: Quantum Ring multiblock fails to form/connect cables on world load until block update

text: [issue by AndreMatos28] ### Describe the bug Describe the bug Every time I load into my world, the ME Quantum Ring multiblock appears visually and functionally unformed. The ME Glass Cables connected to it act as if the multiblock is missing, failing to pass power/channels. Any manual block update or interaction (such as breaking and replacing a ring block or breaking/replacing any connected cable) instantly forces the structure to update and form properly. Environment / Version Applied Energistics 2 Version: 19.2.17 Minecraft Version: 1.21.1 Mod Loader: NeoForge Version 21.1.248 Additional context Triggering a block update by removing and replacing a single block or cable fixes the issue immediately until the next log out/rejoin. ### How to reproduce the bug Build and form a functional ME Quantum Ring multiblock connected to an ME Network using ME Glass Cables. Save and quit to the main menu (or restart the world/server). Reload the world. Observe that the Quantum Ring is unformed and the cables fail to connect properly until a block update occurs. ### Expected behavior The Quantum Ring should automatically form and reconnect to the network immediately upon loading the world or chunk. ### Additional details My mods. - industrialforegoing: 1 [... truncated] [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] Your answer to the question which version you are using is 26.1 and that contradicts your pack description mentioning 1.21.1 consistently, so I think that is a mistake. Reminds me of #7935 a bit, but that fix should already be in your version. With your description I could not reproduce that problem with only AE2. Therefore I suspect another random condition that must be fulfilled to reproduce it. Does it happen with your pack in a clean world? Where are the chunk borders in relation to the quantum ring and the connected cable (F3+G and a screenshot)? If it streches across two chunks that might make a difference. [comment by AndreMatos28 (none)] After testing the setup mod by mod in a clean environment, I found that this is not an issue native to AE2 or chunk loading directly, but rather a compatibility conflict caused by another mod in the pack _'Time in a Bottle Fix'_ (tiab-entity-fix-1.0.3.jar). When _'Time in a Bottle Fix'_ is present, it disrupts the Quantum Ring structure update upon world load, requiring a manual block update to normalize. Once I removed/isolated that specific mod, the Quantum Ring formed and loaded correctly every time without needing any manual interaction.
